- [USER] Asks about the difference between full-grain and top-grain leather and if one is better than the other.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained the differences between full-grain and top-grain leather:
  * Full-grain leather is the highest quality, retains natural grain, develops a patina, and is extremely durable.
  * Top-grain leather is sanded for a smoother finish, less durable than full-grain, and may not develop a patina as nicely.
- [USER] Expresses preference for a full-grain leather wallet but is concerned about finding one within budget.
